config.title: Clinical settings
config.subtitle: Settings an administrator may change. Every change is recorded.
config.versionExplain: Records created from now on are stamped with this version, so a result can always be traced back to the settings that produced it.
config.neverChanged: Never changed since this device was set up.
config.idleLabel: Sign out after this many minutes of no activity
config.idleHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} minutes. A shared clinic phone left signed in is how one person's account ends up recording someone else's assessment.
config.severityIntro: The score at which each severity band begins. Each band must start higher than the one before it.
config.thresholdsReadOnlyBody: The thresholds that decide whether a recording is called a possible finding are built into the analysis software and cannot be changed from this screen. Changing them is a code change and a new release. They are shown here so you can see what this build is using.
config.loadFailed: The settings could not be read, so they are not shown. They have not been changed.
config.severityNotConnectedBody: No severity model exists yet, so nothing reads these bands. They are saved and given a version so that the first scored record has a version to point back at.
config.thresholdsTechnicalNote: These are technical values for the research team. They are shown so a result can be traced back to the exact settings that produced it. There is nothing for you to do with them.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Everything the app has recorded about who did what, newest first.
audit.loadFailed: The activity log could not be read. This does not mean nothing has been recorded.

translations.title: Translation worklist
translations.subtitle: Every text the app looked for and could not find in the chosen language. These fell back to English.
translations.empty: Nothing is missing. Every text the app has asked for was available.
translations.emptyHint: This list fills up as the app is used in a language other than English.
translations.sortedNote: Most needed first — translating the top of this list helps the most people.
translations.copyHint: The key is where the text lives in the translation files.
translations.loadFailed: The list could not be read. This does not mean nothing is missing.

error.CONFIG_NOT_AUTHORISED: Only an administrator can change these settings.
error.CONFIG_IDLE_TIMEOUT_OUT_OF_RANGE: Choose a number of minutes between 1 and 480.
error.CONFIG_BANDS_NOT_ASCENDING: Each band must start at a higher score than the one before it.
error.CONFIG_BAND_OUT_OF_RANGE: Each band must start at a score between 0 and 100.
error.CONFIG_BANDS_INCOMPLETE: All five severity bands must be present.
error.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong. Please try again.
